title: Foran Singh v. Executive Engineer, Dakshinanchal Electricity Distribution Division & Anr.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Ashok Bhushan, J. and Sunita Agarwal, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed; consumer left to Clause 7.10/7.7 forum.
headnote: After an earlier writ was disposed of as infructuous with liberty to pursue Clause 7.10 read with Clauses 7.7.1 to 7.7.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 against the Executive Engineer's decision on the representation, a second writ seeking mandamus to decide a later representation cannot be entertained. The consumer must avail that Code remedy.
facts: Foran Singh sought a mandamus to the Executive Engineer, Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam, to decide his representation dated 20 May 2011. He had earlier filed Writ-C No. 15059 of 2011, which was disposed of as infructuous because the Engineer had already decided the representation by order dated 4 April 2011, with liberty to take the Supply Code grievance-redressal route. He then filed this second writ for a direction to decide the later representation.

holding_units.topic: forum bar on subsequent writ after 7.10 liberty
holding_units.holding: Where an earlier writ has already been disposed of with liberty to pursue the remedy under Clause 7.10 read with Clauses 7.7.1 to 7.7.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 against the licensee's decision on a representation, a subsequent writ seeking mandamus to decide a further representation cannot be entertained; the consumer must avail that statutory forum.

not_decided.point: merits of the 4.4.2011 order and the 20.5.2011 representation
not_decided.note: Court refused to entertain the second writ and left the consumer to the Clause 7.10/7.7 forum.
